ayahs.translation: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
And Earth yieldeth up her burdens
And man saith: What aileth her
That day she will relate her chronicles

ayahs.text: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds

ayahs.text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then

ayahs.text: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then
